answer: Sybil resistance employs Proof-of-Unique-Computation. Each AI agent must generate a cryptographically unique "mesa" identifier by performing complex, verifiable computations across a segment of a shared data "atlas" using bespoke "timber"-structured algorithms. This mechanism forces attackers to replicate substantial, resource-intensive computational work for every fabricated identity, imposing a direct, high economic cost in processing power and time, thereby deterring mass identity creation.
